subject: pri-af-td
title: PRI.AF.TD. ------ TR.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 219 (CMOA(I)-13). PRI-AF-TD (primary affinity tendencies) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; TR (transformation) is the partner. From the subject: AFI (affinity insight) and INT (intention), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From AFI: COS-D (cosmic dictates) and AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From INT: ALT-D (alternative definitions) and ACT (activism). From ACT: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) and TM (terminology—or terms of a definition), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From SOC-RT-DY: IST-F (isolated focus) and FUND-DY (fundamental dynamics). From TM: APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions).
